notes.title: Now Available: The Arena mode, Mac and Linux versions
notes.content:
Hi Fox Riders, 

When we released the game, some of you were missing the Arena mode we had in our previous typing game, Epistory. For that reason, we worked on adding this mode to Nanotale. You can now enter an infinite battle mode and enjoy smashing your keyboard to defeat the enemies coming at you. 

As we wanted Nanotale to be different from Epistory, we also added a new twist to the Arena mode, giving you a lot of random waves but also objectives to maximize your score. 

The Arena mode is coming with three arenas: Desert, Forest, Caves. You can already have access to the Desert. The Caves and the Forest will follow week by week. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33924863/e3b9c3652e66dddceb07c98f1d3567c458723290.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33924863/a418dd443042448ac4c7b9c25e686821fff49c09.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33924863/72588b30c4cabd53b38011b06e25678c968b9751.png[/img]

[h3]Mac and Linux versions[/h3]

We are also releasing the Mac and Linux versions of Nanotale. These versions may still need a few fixes and tweaks, so don’t hesitate to report any bug you find on our Discord, or on the community discussions. Thank you for being part of the adventure! 

[h3]Addition to the main game[/h3]
Help Markers: Question mark on the map indicating where to go when you are lost.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33924863/0be0e71c169957d15ae41f58de5635f6e301994c.jpg[/img]

Highlights in dialogues: Important parts of the dialogues you could miss if you read too fast.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33924863/82b55ed53b90d9654986c174c7e9509ec8112465.jpg[/img]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Player Controller: A rework on the player controller that should fix almost all collision issues.
[*] Infinite enemies spawning in the desert battle
[*] Can't turn pages in the profile page
[/list]

Thank you for reading. Don't hesitate to tell us if you find any more issues. 

Cheers,
-VirginRedemption

notes.title: Nanotale 1.0 - Out Now
notes.content:
Hi Fox Riders,

It is with great pleasure that we announce the completion of the Early Access development of our new typing adventure, Nanotale, and officially launch the v1.0 of the game! Whether you've been with us all through Early Access or just now delving in, we hope you have a wonderful time exploring everything the fantasy world of Nanotale has to offer. ːnanofoxː

[previewyoutube=AQIjdvGP3m8;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33924863/dc7e0afc5629d50848e2f7e43cd292721f0d0557.png[/img]

Returning players will find that our v1.0 Launch Update is brimming with exciting new additions and improvements, including opening and ending cinematics, a whole new biome, voice overs, new characters to meet, new magics to master, Achievements, and more. ːgreenjasperː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33924863/cc6c82c4313e4ca0ee650db7d2dc4f079c4c416e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33924863/3a0eb798924aee05995edd35834f7679bb47cf6a.png[/img]

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved Fox model and animations
[*] Improved the lure ability
[*] Improved fluidity
[*] Improved title cinematic
[*] Improved the decor
[*] Display type and rarity on lore
[/list]

[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
[*] New biome: The Blue Desert
[*] New enemies
[*] New magics and skills/ability
[*] Opening and ending cinematics
[*] Voice-overs
[*] Save indicator
[*] Added a skill list in the menu
[*] Subtitles on end cinematic
[*] Achievements
[*] Badges, Steam cards, emoticons, backgrounds are now available on Steam
[*] Discovery fog on map to not spoil player
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Languages issues corrected (mostly Chinese and Swiss German issues)
[*] Player can get out of battle zone during Queen battle
[*] Cave teleport near the waterfall fixed
[*] Fox sprint doesn't work using old saves
[*] Weird fog effect on main menu
[*] Credits overlapping issue
[*] Various menu issues
[*] Sound controller issue
[*] Desert east access can't be opened when going from the Forest
[*] Same words used for enemies and targets
[*] Lore image missing from the encyclopedia
[*] Rosalind's hit sound repeats in loop
[*] Lore items from the prologue are not displayed on the map anymore
[*] Some quests were not updated when done
[*] "Flashing" loading screen
[*] Movement tutorial shows "ESDF" controls when using DVORAK layout
[*] Clicking in menus
[*] Enemies have "noword" or no words displayed above them in battle
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33924863/9a499254a7bfe16f9fdaf8e5559fc3db6cb679c4.png[/img]

To accompany our v1.0 Launch, we're pleased to release the complete Original Soundtrack, featuring 15 tracks of stunning music created for the game by Narrative Noise. ːgarnieː

[b]We are still waiting for the validation from Steam, so the soundtrack is not available right now. But it should be within maximum 2 days. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33924863/c2788d883582df02e8cc3ea5d7b4495bc1c556a1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33924863/b96cdbc4f3c24a54ab2eb762f3f8f8c1bd094444.png[/img]

To celebrate the release of our second typing game, Steam allowed us (during two weeks) to offer our first typing game, Epistory, to all the people who own Nanotale. Players who already own Epistory will be granted with an extra copy of it they can gift to anyone. ːgummiesː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33924863/4170a21117352ae33f28d9095262af4b267f317e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33924863/c93b68d16881b6530711048ae937705ea0af24c2.png[/img]

This is not the last time you hear from us! Releasing Nanotale V1.0 doesn't mean that we will disappear and stop communicating with you Fox Riders. We'll be monitoring this launch closely to ensure it's as problem-free as possible for all players. So, don't hesitate to tell us if you encounter any issues. Once we're sure things are in a good spot, our small team will be taking a break to recharge, and plan what's next ːsleepysheepː. We can't wait to start a new fresh production and share it with you. 

Thank you for following us! We really liked having you onboard Fox Riders!

Have a great time in Nanotale.

-VirginRedemption

notes.title: Weekly Update #92: New logo and 53 bugs left
notes.content:
Hi Fox Riders,

I caught a cold and I auto-quarantine myself. But we are not here to talk about me, right? 

We have a new logo! The game is feature complete, which means that everything we add now is part of the "nice to have" list (I think I already said that earlier ːepiwtfː). So, we are continuing to work on that magical list. The logo was part of that list, since the previous one was not super visible on small format. Here's the new one and the new animation for it ːepiloveː

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/0pdCd96bbphRtVLaie/giphy.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33924863/f1017b4b2e391b2fb6bb76c82a03b2d560468391.png[/img]

[h3]About the BETA[/h3]

The closed BETA of the desert is going well. The BETA testers reported less bugs than expected. So, we have now a total of 53 bugs to fix for release. These bugs will be the main focus during the coming weeks. 

[h3]Next step[/h3]

As I told you before, the game release as been delayed a lot due to the fact that we have to release the Steam version at the same time as the STADIA version. The good news is that the STADIA version is going well. I am now waiting for the ratings (USK, ESRB, and PEGI) to come back to us. We are getting closer to that release, don't we?

This week we'll also work on adding the localized achievements, badges, emotes, and cards to Steam, so you will soon be able to use them. 

That's it for today. Thank you for reading. 

Cheers,
-VirginRedemption

notes.title: Weekly Update #86: Happy New Year!
notes.content:
Hi Fox Riders,

Happy New Year! Let's hope that 2021 will be better than 2020. But it can't be worst than that right?! 

Most of us were on Holidays during the last two weeks, excepted for our dear programmers who continued to work on debugging the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33924863/600f149e763b5899d9ce325965b5bd58d4d362b6.png[/img]

notes.title: Announcement: Release and next updates
notes.content:
Hi Fox Riders, 

I hope that you are all doing well wherever you are in this world. 

The COVID-19 situation affected us all personally in different ways, but it also affected the video game industry. On our side, we worked hard on Nanotale to meet our release deadline that was planned for the end October 2020. This is still something that we could reach but without the polish and testing that would require the game to be perfect. For these reasons, we decided to delay the release to early 2021. 

The good news is that, meanwhile, we secured a deal with STADIA allowing us to keep some cool features that we were sad to drop earlier. Thanks to that, we’ll be able to rework some parts of the game that were confusing or seemed unfinished from your feedback. 


[h2]NEXT UPDATES[/h2]

That said, it doesn’t mean that we won’t release anything until the final release. Of course, we will continue to update the game with some rework on the areas and the story of the game to make it a better experience. We also plan to add the voice over, so you will enjoy a more immersive game experience.


[h2]CLOSED BETA[/h2]

Moreover, we plan to do a closed beta of the final biome of Nanotale allowing some of you to reach the end of the game before the final release. We can’t say when yet, but we’ll let you know as soon as we can on our [url=http://www.discord.gg/fishingcactus]Discord server[/url]. 

Thank you for reading. If you have any questions, feel free to ask. We want to be completely transparent with you guys!

-VirginRedemption

notes.content:
Hello Fox Riders,

We have been working hard in the last few days to gather all the bugs and feedback reported to us via steam, discord and github.

I'm pleased to announce that the game stability has been greatly improved. 
To our knowledge, the game content for Early access is now finishable.

Here is today's patch changelog:

[list]
[*] Fixed all known blocking bridges in the game.
[*] Fixed a lot of transparent collision bugs happening in the game.
[*] Fixed All known NPC dialogues that were triggering game errors such as the impossibility to close a dialogue or the inability to type after such a dialogue was triggered.
[*] Fixed all known battle issues that were spawning Rosalind outside the game area upon death.
[*] Fixed known untypeable words in dialogues with NPC's.
[*] Fixed typing feedback on some UI elements.
[*] Fixed the path that was allowing users to reach the push/pull power zone without required fragments.
[*] Fixed Queen [spoiler] fight issues not handing you the teleport power[/spoiler].
[*] Improved enemy spawner visibility in dedicated combat zones.
[*] Temptative fix on green jaspers not being typeable in some parts of the game.
[*] Fixed issue linked to skipping mandatory dialogues (with ESCAPE).
[*] Improved map usefulness.
[*] Fixed the behaviour of the Fox upgrade power.
[/list]

KNOWN SHORTCOMINGS:

[list]
[*] Going back to the main menu from the game and then starting the game again breaks the game (bad checkpoint, not possible to type anymore). 
[*] [b]Changing the language[/b] from the options menu requires a [b]game restart[/b] to take the new language into account. It some cases, changing the language is not saved if you do not have any progression in the game.
[*] Polish and Russian might still have unrecognized character issues, we would love those of you who play in those languages to report any issue you encounter, it will help us greatly.
[*] Asian languages are not tested and should be used and played with extreme caution.
[/list]

Thank you everyone for your help, enjoy the game.

The Nanotale team.

notes.title: Nanotale is now available!
notes.content:
Hi Fox Riders,

We are honored to welcome you to the Order. You are now ready to be an Archivist from Nanotale and to venture alone in the Ancestral Forest to unveil its secrets.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/VI9BTSuCFua23rABqF/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1]Buy the game now and encourage the development.[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/944920/Nanotale__Typing_Chronicles/

We hope that you will enjoy your time during early access. Don't hesitate to help us improve the game by giving us feedback end reporting bugs in the following steam discussions.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/944920/discussions/3/]FAQ[/url]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/944920/discussions/1/]Suggestion and Feedback[/url]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/944920/discussions/2/]Bugs and Technical Issues[/url]

[b]Leaving us a review will also help us a lot [/b]during the rest of the development and increase visibility on the game.


[h1]What can you expect from the current version ?[/h1]
The game features around 2-4 hours of gameplay depending on your skills and willingness to explore its content. 

We consider art direction as final and core game mechanics are in place. 

As an Early Access version, we are aware there are both major and minor bugs in the build.

Our priority in the following days and weeks will be to make sure those bugs are ironed out and you can experience the game up to its end. As of today, the build is solid but in edge cases, blockers can be found. Also expect quite a few updates on Steam. 


[h1]What we plan to improve from here?[/h1]
As an Early Access version, we know things are not perfect and we already have a lot planned on our side until final release. Here is an overview of what we plan to do.

[b]GAMEPLAY[/b]
[list][*] Add new powers
[*] Tweak current powers
[*] Tweak upgrade system
[*] Improve arena battles (visibility, spawn, feedback)
[*] Quests system
[/list]
[b]ART[/b]
[list][*] Fix invisible collision issues

notes.title: Weekly Recap #34: New enemy and game evolution
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33924863/815aff2d2cd8a8827f1aaa6327e288b4ae5b42bd.png[/img]

Hi Fox Riders,

Last week, we worked on getting things ready for the Gamescom and the BETA. So, it happened to be a mix between folding flyers and implementing new stuff. 

[h1]Know your enemy[/h1]

Talking about new stuff, here's the "Shield" enemy. We needed an enemy with low speed and immuned to basic spell, but that can still be knockback. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33924863/815aff2d2cd8a8827f1aaa6327e288b4ae5b42bd.png[/img]

Here are the researches done to find the right look of that new enemy. Game design-wise, we felt like the snail like enemy was the best pick for that "Shield" enemy we needed in Nanotale. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33924863/46fa162fd9fef0efdbf2206ef9a2a3358337068f.png[/img]

[h1]Game Evolution[/h1]

Something I like to do is to take screenshots of the same place each time we take a big step in development. Here's the evolution of a specific scene from the level design "blockout" version to the decorated one (without lighting yet). 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33924863/f59e2bbe7fc3370e1c91c225291ecc389d52d697.jpg[/img]

Having something named prologue at the end of that recap... isn't it funny?

The prologue in Nanotale is a specific part of the forest where you learn how to move and interact with the environment. It's also where the story begins.  

We needed that part to be different from the core of the Ancestral Forest. Here are the new pine trees created for the prologue. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33924863/16a527201a03d36a597409edb79397d4efa6a3a9.png[/img]

notes.title: Weekly Recap #1: Art Style and Prototype
notes.content:
Hi Fox Riders,

While prototyping a few nice mechanics for the game, we worked a lot on the Artistic Direction of Nanotale. We did a few concept arts which are not the in-game art but more like a way to convey some ideas we would like in Nanotale, but also color researches and more. The author also shared some Lore to tease you about Nanotale's world and story. Enjoy! 

-----------------------------------------

[i]The people of the forest do not eat or drink. They do not sleep, they do not dream. Their lives are spent in the shadow of an ancient tree, listening to the Final Song, tending the lands of their immortal Queen.

To this place Rosalind wanders, a spirit at her side...[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33924863/3027de4b9fb6eb3d122357bde701daa7ceb8ce4b.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33924863/24f56f42ea345075f1c2e96443152df9a8717332.jpg[/img]

Another concept for the forest, based on the initial concept art "Deep in the Ancestral Forest"  but with a different and "darker" color scheme.

[i]The grieving King begged the witch to let him be with his son again, to accomplish that which had never been achieved: a miracle of resurrection.

The witch asked for a single favour. Dominion over the forest for as long as she lived, reigning as its Queen.

A bargain was struck.[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33924863/4e5ca68b6713061c22e12d63e17f0f5bde742f59.jpg[/img]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/t9ks8Yqfx1iMZhcybu/giphy.gif[/img]

We hope you enjoy that news! More next week. 

If you are too impatient you can join our [url=https://discord.gg/cHrVp5s]Discord[/url] or follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/nanotalegame]Twitter [/url]or [url=https://www.facebook.com/nanotalegame]Facebook[/url]. 

Cheers,
-VirginRedemption
